summary.text: An abyssal plain is an underwater plain on the deep ocean floor, usually found 3,000 to 6,000 metres below the surface.
It forms where fine clay and silt settle over the uneven crust made by seafloor spreading, covering its bumps.
Scarce oxygen makes it hard on surface life, and darkness and high water pressure make it hard for people to explore.

facts.label: Where it lies
facts.value: Between a continental rise and a mid-ocean ridge

facts.label: Oxygen source
facts.value: Much came from polar regions that melted long ago

facts.label: Least explored
facts.value: Among Earth's flattest and least explored regions

items.prompt: Picture a slice through an ocean basin, starting at a coastline and heading out to sea. Between which two features does an abyssal plain usually sit?

options.label: The beach and the continental shelf
A trench and a volcanic island arc
The shelf and the continental slope
The continental rise and a mid-ocean ridge

items.explain: Abyssal plains lie generally between the foot of a continental rise and a mid-ocean ridge.

items.prompt: Where did much of the dissolved oxygen in the water over abyssal plains originally come from?

options.label: Polar regions that melted long ago
Plants growing on the plain itself
Rain falling far out at sea

items.explain: Much of the dissolved oxygen in abyssal plains came from polar regions that had melted long ago.

items.prompt: A survey robot crawls across a patch of abyssal plain looking for metals. What might it find lying there?
items.explain: Metallic nodules are common in some areas of the plains, holding metals such as manganese, iron, nickel, cobalt and copper.

items.prompt: Why do scientists suspect abyssal plains hold a great deal of the world's biodiversity?

options.label: Their water is rich in oxygen

items.explain: Owing in part to their vast size, abyssal plains are believed to be major reservoirs of biodiversity.

items.prompt: Abyssal plains influence how much carbon dioxide is in the atmosphere. Over what kind of time span does that effect play out?

options.label: A hundred to a thousand years

items.explain: Abyssal plains influence ocean carbon cycling and atmospheric CO₂ over time scales of a hundred to a thousand years.

items.prompt: A crewed submersible prepares to dive to an abyssal plain. Which two conditions there have kept such plains poorly explored?
items.explain: Darkness and water pressure that can reach about 750 times atmospheric pressure mean abyssal plains are not well explored.
